ns2:section.sectionText: The Mythology of Greece and Rome. 3 hours. Studies the major myths of Greece and Rome and their impact upon later art, music, and literature. This course satisfies the General Education Criteria for a Literature and the Arts, and Western Compartv Culture course. First year Discovery Program course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course.
